decisions.evidence: Across all six neighbors, the same pattern emerges: the query repeatedly carries features such as lactone, aromatic heterocycles, quinoline, tertiary aliphatic amine, and tertiary hydroxyl that are locally associated with the DILI-positive class, while the few opposing signals are either weaker or isolated. Because the positive-neighbor comparisons consistently favor the same label and the negative-neighbor comparisons also end up pointing the same way, the combined evidence supports option (B): can cause DILI.
